title: EXT_state_series glTF Document Extension
description: Draft KHR-track proposal extension carrying named, time-sampled, non-pose per-object state (velocity, applied force/torque, action, joint state, pose uncertainty) that rides alongside a standard glTF pose animation, sharing its time accessor. Channels target arbitrary glTF objects via JSON Pointer (RFC 6901), resolved with the same rules KHR_animation_pointer uses for its own `pointer` extension property. See ../README.md.

timesAccessor.description: Index of the shared time accessor (float32 seconds, SCALAR). MAY also be used as an AnimationSampler.input for a co-existing pose animation; if so, that sampler's interpolation MUST be STEP (see README, 'Shared time accessor and invariants').
